verdict.rationale: An official iOS app is documented through the Apple App Store listing ('Muse from Meta'), and the homepage presents the mobile app as a primary client offering chat, goals, approvals, connectors, notifications and the activity log, so the iOS side looks full-featured. Nothing in the evidence names an Android app; 'mobile' is used only generically. missing for 10: evidence of an official Android app, confirmation of feature parity across iOS and Android, independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps' completeness.
